critical_steps: The direct-sum vectors a⊕2b and a⊕b are linearly independent for nonzero a and b.
Each component pair is linearly dependent, so each component 2-inner-product square vanishes.
Their componentwise sum therefore vanishes, contradicting the defining 2-inner-product axiom.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct use of the source's own nondegeneracy axiom and an exact two-vector construction.
integrity.unproved_limits: No classification of valid direct sums for arbitrary abstract n-inner-product spaces is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The counterexample disproves the universal componentwise direct-sum n-inner-product construction by specializing to n=2.
The canonical repair described is limited to Hilbert-induced 2-inner products.
No corrected direct-sum controlled-frame theorem is asserted under the repaired geometry.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same observation.
title: The componentwise direct-sum formula fails the defining axiom of a 2-inner product
